Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Take a third ui lane seat" (`cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Uc2nCvWvLyYyaVYaUhakpJ`) one message with your branch name and wait. Read-only measuring is fine meanwhile. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27423` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main` (`git checkout --detach` the main checkout first, then `git worktree add --no-track -B <branch> ../objectstack-issue-27423 origin/main`); `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27423 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (no time-shaped stamp inside the fenced report JSON). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, line 3 `Fixes #27423`, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran` (merge `origin/main` first if it refuses as STALE TREE); `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. Build the closure your tests import first (`bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '<pkg>^...' build"`). Changeset in the root `.changeset/` for each published package your diff changes (app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green. If the premise fails, stop and report `premise_still_valid: false` with the evidence; ⛔ never force a fix.


### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

This is a p0 main-red anchor (#27047). #27076's ruling carries over, as the card says: **never raise the timeout, skip the case, add a retry, or weaken an assertion.** The fix is the test's own cost. Every assertion stays byte-identical in meaning.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` c5d46341 (read-only), `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts` (2106 lines):
- Two cases each run a whole-repository sweep inside their own 15 s budget: `sweep(repoRoot)` at ≈L1718 (the red one, "keeps every key it makes reachable OUT of both tiers") and ≈L2012 (another describe).
- Every other `sweep(...)` call takes a fixture root and is cheap.
- Measure whether the describe at ≈L1718 already does repo-wide work in a `beforeAll` (`packKeys`, `collected`, `headsAtHopSite`). If it does, the sweep belongs there too.

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

1. Compute the repo-wide `sweep(repoRoot)` once per file: a module-level memo, or one `beforeAll` shared by both describes. Then read that result in both cases. If `sweep` mutates state or returns mutable structures, freeze or clone the result so the two cases cannot leak into each other.
2. Measure both cases' durations before and after, unloaded and under load. Load means running the file beside a locked ui suite, the way this repo's memory says reproduces the 15 s timeout. Put the numbers in the PR body, as the card's "Done when" requires.
3. A `beforeAll` has its own hook timeout. Measure that it stays inside the hook budget under load. If it doesn't, say so and stop; do not raise any timeout.

Also measure, read-only, whether `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` has the same in-case repo sweep shape. Report it as a finding; do not fix it here.

### Scope

File surface:
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-dead-keys.test.ts`
- `ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs`, only if a read-only memo seam is needed and only if measured necessary

No changeset: a test-only change under `ui/scripts`. Measure the repo's changeset rule for `ui/scripts/**` and follow it, using a `skip-changeset` label request in the report if that is the convention.

### Tier

`TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S). `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`. Not governed. p0: work this before anything else in your thread.
